name: AI SEO Booster – Audit, Optimize & Boost Your Google Rank Up
author: SEO Booster

sections.description:
🚀 SEO Booster with AI-Powered Site Audit and Ranking Tools – Your Easy, Free SEO & Content Partner

Boost My SEO with AI is a simple and free WordPress plugin that helps you improve your SEO automatically using the power of AI.

You don’t need to be an expert — just set it up once, and the plugin will:

📝 Write and post SEO-friendly articles for you

🧠 Rewrite your existing content to improve rankings

🔍 Check your site’s SEO health and suggest fixes

📄 Analyze SEO status of each page and post separately

It’s like having your own SEO assistant working behind the scenes every day!
✅ Key Features:

🌐 Full-site SEO analysis made simple

📄 Check SEO score of every post and page

✍️ Generate content like blog posts, About Us pages, and more using AI

🔁 Rewrite your pages with AI to match trending keywords

🔑 Check keyword density and optimize for better performance

📱 Make sure your site looks great on mobile devices

📅 Schedule and automate daily posts to keep your site active

🧰 Perfect for bloggers, small businesses, freelancers, and agencies

🔄 Set it and forget it — the plugin works automatically in the background

💡 Why Use It?

Free & Easy – Anyone can use it, no tech skills needed

Saves Time – Let AI handle daily posts and SEO tasks

Boosts Ranking – Fresh, optimized content helps improve Google visibility

Works for You – Whether you’re busy running your business or just starting a blog

📈 Want better SEO without extra effort?
Install Boost My SEO with AI today and let it do the work for you!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Boost My SEO with AI menu in the admin dashboard.
  4. For page / post SEO, you can check it individual page / post.
sections.faq:
What does “Boost My SEO with AI” plugin do?

It helps improve your WordPress website’s SEO automatically. It can:

Analyze SEO status of your whole site and individual posts/pages

Rewrite or generate content using AI

Schedule and publish SEO-friendly posts automatically

Suggest SEO improvements to rank higher on Google

Is this plugin free to use?

Yes! It’s designed to give small businesses, bloggers, and beginners powerful SEO tools.

Do I need to be an SEO expert to use it?

No! This plugin is made for non-technical users. Everything is automated — from SEO checks to AI content creation and posting. You just install, configure, and let it work for you.

Does it analyze SEO for individual pages and posts?

Yes, absolutely. The plugin checks SEO status for each post and page separately, so you can see what needs improvement and where to focus.

Can it create content for me?

Yes! The plugin can:

Generate blog posts

Create About Us, Contact, and other page content

Rewrite existing posts to make them more SEO-friendly

All using AI with just a few clicks.

Can it post automatically for me?

Yes. You can automate daily or scheduled posts, and it will publish fresh, optimized content to keep your site active and improve rankings.

How does the content rewriting feature work?

You can choose a post or page, and the plugin will rewrite it using AI based on keywords or SEO suggestions. This helps improve your ranking without needing to write everything yourself.

Does it check for mobile responsiveness?

Yes, the plugin includes a mobile responsiveness check, which ensures your pages look good on all devices — a key factor for SEO.

How does the SEO checker work?

The plugin automatically checks your content for important SEO factors like:

Page/post title length

Heading structure (H1, H2, etc.)

Keyword usage and placement

Image alt text

Meta descriptions

Mobile readiness
and more elements...

It then suggests improvements — and even lets you rewrite content using AI with a single click for better SEO performance.

🚀 How does it improve my website’s SEO ranking with AI?

This plugin uses AI to boost your SEO in several smart ways:

✍️ Generates content like blog posts, About pages, and more

🔁 Rewrites existing content to make it clearer and more keyword-optimized

🏷 Writes meta titles, descriptions, and keywords automatically

🔧 Detects and suggest technical SEO issues (like missing headings or alt text)

📅 Posts content automatically to keep your site fresh and active

With AI handling the time-consuming SEO tasks, your site becomes more search-friendly — helping it rank higher on Google and saving you hours of manual work.
